Landed on local main at 2ec85a5 (7 commits ending 2ec85a5): selection algebra + named selections, versioned snapshots with strict JSON, undo/redo with documented boundaries, InspectorModel/InspectorPanel, FilterCommand, browser widget workflows.

Evidence at exact SHA 2ec85a5:
- scalafmtCheckAll testAll exit 0 (16 targets, 2242 tests)
- tools/check-compatibility.sh pass; tools/check-links.sh pass
- tools/check-browser-suites.py: 15/15 jobs exit 0; paired traces equal (widget, linked, history)
- tools/check-browser-consumer.sh: 10/10 in Chromium 151.0.7922.34
- tools/check-history-browser.cjs, SVG and Canvas, 8 checks against JS set/bin oracles: save sweep + bin members; union/intersection/difference; keyboard undo/redo (both redo shortcuts) with linked follow and nothing recorded in the linked plot; a 20-frame pan is one entry, viewport undo/redo; snapshot survives reload; tampered schema/codec/revision/text refused with selection, saved selections and window unchanged; inspector "k of n selected" vs oracle; filter report and reconciled selection.

Fresh-context review of the browser slices: H1 per-frame navigation history, H2 categorical-axis followViewport, M1 resize clearing history, M2 unguarded state listeners, keyboard/doc overclaims - all fixed in 2ec85a5.
Unit-only or gap rows are marked in docs/browser-capabilities.md: link/resolver non-effects (Unit), exact member lists (Unit), categorical-axis restore (Gap: no fixture builds a categorical axis). Not pushed.
